name: paper-route
description: Save local documents into a 1Password vault with minimal friction

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/styles.css dist/renderer/
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.install-quick-action: npm run build && node scripts/quick-action.mjs install
